summary: Hyundai ABS Funding LLC, as depositor, filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of notes by Hyundai Auto Receivables Trust 2026-B, a securitization of auto loans. The filing includes legal opinions from Mayer Brown LLP regarding legality and tax matters. No special-situation event is involved; this is a routine asset-backed securities offering. The terms (class sizes, pricing) are not disclosed in the excerpt. The registrant is the depositor, not engaging in a merger, tender, or restructuring. This filing is standard for a structured finance vehicle issuance and does not trigger any risk-arb or corporate event analysis.
